messages:
emily (eng-security): Quick check — we have a customer asking if SCIM deprovisioning will remove group memberships instantly or just mark soft-delete. Anyone confirm current behavior?

sam (infra): It marks user as inactive in DB and queues a SCIM delete to IdP. By default we soft-delete for 14d, removing most access but leaving audit trail. :+1:

ravi (identity): Slight tweak: soft-delete sets disabled=true in our user record and removes OAuth tokens; group memberships are removed on SCIM PATCH during the delete workflow. If downstream IdP honors it depends on their mapping.

natalie (product): For compliance we need to be able to hard-delete on request within 48h. Is that a manual workflow?

emily (eng-security): Yes — we have a special admin flow that triggers hard delete and redaction. Need to confirm logs redact PII (email) after hard delete. @ravi

ravi (identity): Audit logs keep an obfuscated identifier after redaction. We run redaction job post-hard-delete. Config is `audit.redact_email = true`. Example:
```
{ "audit": { "redact_email": true, "retain_days": 365 } }
```

sam (infra): Note: retention still keeps hashed/email fingerprint for deduping — not raw email. We can add an option to drop fingerprint on extreme requests but that'll break some dedupe analytics.

emily (eng-security): Ok. Also question about group mapping — the customer uses nested groups. Our SCIM mapping flattens by default. Is there a toggle to preserve nesting -> role mapping?

ravi (identity): Not currently exposed. We have `scim.flatten_groups = true`. Can change per-org via admin API. Example PATCH:
```
PATCH /admin/orgs/{org_id}
{ "scim": { "flatten_groups": false } }
```

natalie (product): Product ask: add an admin UI toggle? If so we'll surface default warning re: sync performance.

emily (eng-security): For immediate customer: I can enable flatten_groups=false for their org but want signoff on security implications (more group calls, potential larger token sizes). @sam any infra concerns?

sam (infra): Perf impact minimal at their user counts (<2k). Approve from infra.

ravi (identity): I'll enable it and run a dry-sync. Will post logs here once complete.

audit-bot: SCIM sync started for org_12345 — job 98765

ravi (identity): Dry-sync done. No PII in logs; see snippet: `user.email=REDACTED` lines only. Took 12s. Will schedule final sync after approval.

emily (eng-security): Thanks. One last thing — can we add a short note in customer-facing doc about deprovision grace period and redaction? I'll PR.

natalie (product): I'll review the PR. :rocket:

emily (eng-security): Approved. Closing this thread once PR merged.
